title: [review] project-LICHEN-2auf.44.7.1: lichen-node routing.rs missing dao_admission parameter to process_signature_verified
description:
## Location
`rust/lichen-node/src/routing.rs:857`

## Problem
`process_signature_verified()` was modified in `lichen-rpl` to accept a 7th parameter `dao_admission: &DaoAdmissionState`, but the call site in `lichen-node/src/routing.rs` at line 857 was not updated. The call passes only 6 arguments.

## Impact
Compilation failure across the workspace. `lichen-node` depends on `lichen-rpl` and the signature mismatch prevents building with `--features std`.

## Fix
Add `dao_admission` argument to the `process_signature_verified` call in `lichen-node/src/routing.rs` line 857. The `lichen-node` crate likely needs its own `DaoAdmissionState` instance or access to one.
